findings.title: Missing notices are presented as proof the result never changed
findings.page_quote: no result-change notice for this topic in docs/result_changes.json at this build: the served result has not changed since first publication.

evidence.quote: Pool changed because a design refusal was added: reconstructed cluster, crossover, cluster-crossover, and stepped-wedge trials require a held design-adjusted effect or an ICC design-effect variance before this engine can consume them.
Any earlier same-scope k/parity note is superseded for this build

findings.why: The review explicitly records a changed pool. Absence of a result-change notice does not establish an unchanged publication history.
findings.fix: State only that no result-change notice is recorded; disclose the recorded design-refusal change separately.

findings.title: Claim-check wording implies primary-result coverage despite zero checked claims
findings.page_quote: The claim check (reproduction.claim_check) compares the page's statements about the primary result with this object
findings.why: The wording suggests the primary-result statements received this check, but the recorded primary-result coverage is zero.
findings.fix: Render the recorded coverage counts and explicitly state that no primary outcome-result claim was checked.

findings.title: Mortality forest silently omits the contributing PLUS trial
findings.page_quote: <svg viewBox='0 0 640 116' role='img' aria-label='Forest plot: Mortality' style='max-width:100%;height:auto;font:12px system-ui'><line x1='456.6' y1='24' x2='456.6' y2='92' stroke='#78909c' stroke-dasharray='3 3'/><line x1='190.0' y1='30.0' x2='580.0' y2='30.0' stroke='#37474f'/><rect x='376.5' y='27.0' width='6' height='6' fill='#1d3b4d'/><text x='6' y='34.0' fill='#12232e'>34375394</text><text x='586' y='34.0' fill='#37474f'>0.97 [0.9, 1.05]</text><text x='190' y='110' fill='#546e7a'>pooled first-event ratio (1 HR + 1 RR) (log scale, null=1)</text></svg>

evidence.quote: PLUS has no committed published HR in the cached abstract; the row has counts only. The outcome decision prefers HR where committed, so PLUS remains a reconstructed RR until the full-text HR is retrieved.

findings.why: The plot shows only PMID 34375394 although its axis describes one HR plus one RR. PLUS contributes to the synthesis but has neither a plotted row nor a stated omission reason.
findings.fix: Show the contributing RR on the correctly labelled mixed-measure plot, or explicitly identify the omitted trial and explain why it cannot be plotted.

findings.title: Same-question verdict conflicts with the recorded comparator qualification

evidence.quote: The 2012 Heart meta-analysis (PMID 22442198) is a RELATED, BROADER comparator, not a same-scope one: it pooled more trials including open-label studies and mixed primary/secondary prevention (first-attack and recurrent) populations, whereas this review pools double-blind recurrence-outcome trials. Treat the overlap as approximate.

findings.why: The unqualified positive verdict conflicts with the same tab's source-backed explanation that the comparator is broader and overlap is approximate.
findings.fix: Qualify the verdict as a related, broader comparator and retain the recorded scope differences.
